<!-- Source: /operations/directives/include -->

# include

Directs the executor to include this field or fragment only when the `if` argument is true.

```graphql
directive @include(
  if: Boolean!
) on 
  | FIELD
  | FRAGMENT_SPREAD
  | INLINE_FRAGMENT
```

## Arguments

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">include</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">if</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">Boolean!</code></span>](/types/scalars/boolean.mdx) :badge[non-null] :badge[scalar]

Included when true.

<!-- Source: /operations/directives/skip -->

# skip

Directs the executor to skip this field or fragment when the `if` argument is true.

```graphql
directive @skip(
  if: Boolean!
) on 
  | FIELD
  | FRAGMENT_SPREAD
  | INLINE_FRAGMENT
```

## Arguments

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">skip</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">if</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">Boolean!</code></span>](/types/scalars/boolean.mdx) :badge[non-null] :badge[scalar]

Skipped when true.

<!-- Source: /operations/mutations/archive-project -->

# archiveProject

Archive a project that is no longer active.

```graphql
archiveProject(
  id: ID!
): Project!
```

## Arguments

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">archiveProject</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">id</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">ID!</code></span>](/types/scalars/id.mdx) :badge[non-null] :badge[scalar]

The unique identifier of the project to archive.

## Type

### [<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">Project</code></span>](/types/objects/project.mdx) :badge[object]

A unit of work tracked in the workspace.

## Example

```graphql
mutation ArchiveProject($id: ID!) {
  archiveProject(id: $id) {
    id
    name
    status
    updatedAt
  }
}
```

# createFolder

Create a virtual folder in the workspace.

```graphql
createFolder(
  name: String!
  parentId: ID
): Folder!
```

## Arguments

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">createFolder</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">name</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">String!</code></span>](/types/scalars/string.mdx) :badge[non-null] :badge[scalar]

The name of the new folder.

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">createFolder</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">parentId</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">ID</code></span>](/types/scalars/id.mdx) :badge[scalar]

The optional parent folder identifier.

## Type

### [<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">Folder</code></span>](/types/objects/folder.mdx) :badge[object]

A virtual folder used to organize workspace resources.

## Example

```graphql
mutation CreateFolder($name: String!, $parentId: ID) {
  createFolder(name: $name, parentId: $parentId) {
    id
    name
  }
}
```

# createProject

Create a project and assign its initial owner.

```graphql
createProject(
  input: CreateProjectInput!
): Project!
```

## Arguments

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">createProject</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">input</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">CreateProjectInput!</code></span>](/types/inputs/create-project-input.mdx) :badge[non-null] :badge[input]

The project attributes to create.

## Type

### [<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">Project</code></span>](/types/objects/project.mdx) :badge[object]

A unit of work tracked in the workspace.

## Example

```graphql
mutation CreateProject($input: CreateProjectInput!) {
  createProject(input: $input) {
    id
    name
    status
    folder {
      id
      name
    }
  }
}
```

# folders

```graphql
folders(
  limit: Int
  offset: Int
): [Folder!]!
```

Number of folders to skip before returning results.

### [<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">Folder</code></span>](/types/objects/folder.mdx) :badge[object]

# projects

List projects, optionally filtered by lifecycle status.

```graphql
projects(
  status: ProjectStatus
  limit: Int
): ProjectConnection!
```

## Arguments

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">projects</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">status</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">ProjectStatus</code></span>](/types/enums/project-status.mdx) :badge[enum]

Limit results to projects in this lifecycle stage.

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">projects</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">limit</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">Int</code></span>](/types/scalars/int.mdx) :badge[scalar]

Maximum number of projects to return. Defaults to 20.

## Type

### [<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">ProjectConnection</code></span>](/types/objects/project-connection.mdx) :badge[object]

A paginated project result set.

## Example

```graphql
query ListActiveProjects($status: ProjectStatus) {
  projects(status: $status) {
    totalCount
    nodes {
      id
      name
      status
      owner {
        name
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- Source: /operations/queries/search -->

# search

Search folders, projects, and users from a single endpoint.

```graphql
search(
  query: String!
): [SearchResult!]!
```

## Arguments

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">search</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">query</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">String!</code></span>](/types/scalars/string.mdx) :badge[non-null] :badge[scalar]

Text matched against folder, project, and user names.

## Type

### [<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">SearchResult</code></span>](/types/unions/search-result.mdx) :badge[union]

A result returned from global workspace search.

## Example

```graphql
query SearchWorkspace($query: String!) {
  search(query: $query) {
    __typename
    ... on Folder {
      id
      name
    }
    ... on Project {
      id
      name
      status
    }
    ... on User {
      id
      name
      email
    }
  }
}
```

# folderCreated

Receive folders as they are created in the workspace.

```graphql
folderCreated(
  parentId: ID
): Folder!
```

## Arguments

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">folderCreated</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">parentId</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">ID</code></span>](/types/scalars/id.mdx) :badge[scalar]

Limit events to folders created under this parent.

## Type

### [<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">Folder</code></span>](/types/objects/folder.mdx) :badge[object]

A virtual folder used to organize workspace resources.

## Example

```graphql
subscription WatchFolders($parentId: ID) {
  folderCreated(parentId: $parentId) {
    id
    name
    parent
    createdAt
  }
}
```

<!-- Source: /operations/subscriptions/project-changed -->

# projectChanged

Receive an event whenever a project changes in the workspace.

```graphql
projectChanged(
  projectId: ID
  types: [ProjectEventType!]
): ProjectEvent!
```

## Arguments

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">projectChanged</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">projectId</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">ID</code></span>](/types/scalars/id.mdx) :badge[scalar]

Limit events to a single project.

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">projectChanged</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">types</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">\[ProjectEventType!\]</code></span>](/types/enums/project-event-type.mdx) :badge[list] :badge[enum]

Limit events to these change kinds.

## Type

### [<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">ProjectEvent</code></span>](/types/objects/project-event.mdx) :badge[object]

A change delivered to subscribers watching a project.

## Example

```graphql
subscription WatchProject($projectId: ID, $types: [ProjectEventType!]) {
  projectChanged(projectId: $projectId, types: $types) {
    type
    occurredAt
    project {
      id
      name
      status
    }
    actor {
      name
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- Source: /types/directives/deprecated -->

# deprecated

Marks an element of a GraphQL schema as no longer supported.

```graphql
directive @deprecated(
  reason: String!
) on 
  | FIELD_DEFINITION
  | ARGUMENT_DEFINITION
  | INPUT_FIELD_DEFINITION
  | ENUM_VALUE
  | DIRECTIVE_DEFINITION
```

## Arguments

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">deprecated</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">reason</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">String!</code></span>](/types/scalars/string.mdx) :badge[non-null] :badge[scalar]

Explains why this element was deprecated, usually also including a suggestion for how to access supported similar data. Formatted using the Markdown syntax, as specified by [CommonMark](https://commonmark.org/).

<!-- Source: /types/directives/deprecated-type -->

# deprecatedType

Marks an object type as superseded when standard @deprecated cannot be applied.

```graphql
directive @deprecatedType(
  reason: String!
) on OBJECT
```

# ProjectEventType

The kind of change that occurred on a project.

```graphql
enum ProjectEventType {
  CREATED
  UPDATED
  ARCHIVED
}
```

## Values

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">ProjectEventType</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">CREATED</code></span>

The project was created.

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">ProjectEventType</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">UPDATED</code></span>

One or more project fields were updated.

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">ProjectEventType</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">ARCHIVED</code></span>

The project was archived.

## Member Of

[`projectChanged`](/operations/subscriptions/project-changed.mdx)  :badge[subscription]<Bullet />[`ProjectEvent`](/types/objects/project-event.mdx)  :badge[object]

# ProjectStatus

The lifecycle stage of a project.

```graphql
enum ProjectStatus {
  DRAFT
  ACTIVE
  ARCHIVED
}
```

## Values

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">ProjectStatus</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">DRAFT</code></span>

The project is being planned and is not yet active.

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">ProjectStatus</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">ACTIVE</code></span>

The project is active and available to collaborators.

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">ProjectStatus</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">ARCHIVED</code></span>

The project is retained for history and no longer active.

## Member Of

[`CreateProjectInput`](/types/inputs/create-project-input.mdx)  :badge[input]<Bullet />[`Project`](/types/objects/project.mdx)  :badge[object]<Bullet />[`projects`](/operations/queries/projects.mdx)  :badge[query]

# Folder

A virtual folder used to organize workspace resources.

```graphql
type Folder implements Node {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  parent: String
  createdAt: DateTime!
}
```

## Fields

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">Folder</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">id</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">ID!</code></span>](/types/scalars/id.mdx) :badge[non-null] :badge[scalar]

The unique identifier of the folder.

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">Folder</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">name</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">String!</code></span>](/types/scalars/string.mdx) :badge[non-null] :badge[scalar]

The human-readable folder name.

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">Folder</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">parent</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">String</code></span>](/types/scalars/string.mdx) :badge[scalar]

The identifier of the parent folder, when nested.

### <span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-parent">Folder</code>.<code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">createdAt</code></span><Bullet />[<span className="gqlmd-mdx-entity"><code className="gqlmd-mdx-entity-name">DateTime!</code></span>](/types/scalars/date-time.mdx) :badge[non-null] :badge[scalar]

When the folder was created.

# Project

A unit of work tracked in the workspace.

```graphql
type Project implements Node {
  id: ID!
  name: String!

  owner: User!
  folder: Folder
  updatedAt: DateTime!
  state: String @deprecated
}
```

<!-- Source: /types/scalars/id -->

# ID

The `ID` scalar type represents a unique identifier, often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as `"4"`) or integer (such as `4`) input value will be accepted as an ID.

```graphql
scalar ID
```

# Int

The `Int` scalar type represents non-fractional signed whole numeric values. Int can represent values between -(2^31) and 2^31 - 1.

```graphql
scalar Int
```

# String

The `String` scalar type represents textual data, represented as UTF-8 character sequences. The String type is most often used by GraphQL to represent free-form human-readable text.

```graphql
scalar String
```
